items.title: lar cloud: website sign-in and relay

map.destination: Anyone with a lar server signs in on lar.app with an owner account and streams their library away from home through a relay, with no port forwarding. The server registers with the cloud once; clients find it by account.
decisions: Owner accounts live in the cloud, not on each server (#203 research).
Hosting the relay costs about $40 a month for the first 500 owners (#203).
Sign-in uses passkeys first, email links as fallback.
fog: Does the relay only broker connections, or carry the stream too (full TURN)? (#201)
What does the sign-in screen look like on the website and in the apps? (#202)

items.title: Resume playback across devices

map.destination: Stop watching on one device and resume on another at the same second. The server stores each position per device and profile; the Apple apps read it on open.
decisions: Positions are stored per profile, not per device (#181).
Apps poll on foreground; no push for now.

Music app: library, playback, offline and lyrics on every Apple device

threads.title: Map: music app

map.destination: Anyone with a lar server opens the Music app on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV or Apple Watch, browses their whole library by artist, album and playlist, plays it gapless with lyrics, and takes it offline.
decisions: Music lives in its own library type, not a video library with audio files (#301).
Album artist wins over track artist for grouping (#301).
Gapless playback uses the server's pre-joined FLAC streams (#302).
Offline downloads keep the original codec up to 24/96 (#303).
Lyrics come from embedded tags first, then LRCLIB (#304).
No scrobbling in the first release (#301).
The queue syncs across devices through the playback-state API (#305).
ReplayGain is applied on the client, not baked into streams (#302).
Artwork falls back to the folder image, then MusicBrainz (#306).
Smart playlists stay server-side (#305).
The mini player docks above the tab bar on iOS (#307).
watchOS plays downloads only, no streaming (#303).
Search covers artists, albums, tracks and lyrics (#304).
Sorting ignores a leading "The" (#301).
Multi-disc albums show one track list with disc headers (#306).
CarPlay is a separate concept (#307).
The library scan runs incrementally on file change events (#308).
Unknown genres fold into "Other" (#306).
Downloads cap at 20 GB by default, set per device (#303).
Album pages show credits under the track list (#306).
fog: Does shuffle reshuffle when the queue syncs to another device? (#305)
How does the watch pick which downloads to keep when storage runs out? (#303)
Should lyrics scroll with the song or show a static sheet on tvOS? (#309)
Is a 24/96 download worth its size on cellular? (#310)
